camel_example: aliyun alidns DescribeDnsProductInstances --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy createDate --VersionCode version1 --DomainType PUBLIC --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --UserClientIp '192.0.2.0' --Lang en --Direction DESC
description_en: Retrieves a list of paid DNS product instances that match the specified parameters
description_zh: 根据传入参数获取付费版DNS产品实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-dns-product-instances --lang en --user-client-ip 192.0.2.0 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --version-code version1 --domain-type PUBLIC --order-by createDate --direction DESC --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDnsProductInstances

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：
zh：中文
en：英文

默认：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The edition code of the Alibaba Cloud DNS instance
parameters.name: version_code

parameters.help_en:
The type of the domain name. This parameter is not case-sensitive. Valid values:

PUBLIC: authoritative domain name (default)

CACHE: authoritative proxy domain name
parameters.help_zh:
域名类型，大小写不敏感。取值：

PUBLIC：权威托管域名（默认值）

CACHE：权威代理域名
parameters.name: domain_type

parameters.help_en:
The field to sort the results by. Valid values:

createDate: Sorts the results by creation time. This is the default value.

expireDate: Sorts the results by expiration time
parameters.help_zh:
排序参数。取值：
createDate：按创建时间排序（为空时默认按创建时间排序）
expireDate：按过期时间排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order. Valid values:

DESC: Descending order. This is the default value.

ASC: Ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值：
DESC：递减（为空时默认递减排序） 
ASC: 递增
parameters.name: direction
